papers.title_en: CMM-MP: A Novel Memory Pooling Architecture using Purpose-built Memory Device with CXL and Ethernet
papers.authors: Michael Wasef, Gongjin Sun, Edmund Au, Ranjitha Gopalakrishna, Elham Movahedian, Dongyang Li, Senthil Murugesapandian, Caroline Kahn, Shuyu Lyu, Brian Luu, Jason Scott, Namita Kumar, Mehdi Nik, Kwan Huen, Xuebin Yao, Amir Beygi, Luis Vitorio Cargnini, Ramdas Kachare
papers.evidence: 基于CXL的内存池化架构，面向解耦云中GPU/CPU应用
papers.tldr: 新兴内存密集型负载亟需高容量、低延迟的内存扩展方案。CMM-MP提出业界首款融合CXL与以太网的专用内存池化设备，实现无侵入式TB级内存扩容。实测延迟仅2.7 μs、吞吐达23 GB/s，显著优于RDMA方案。该架构支持池化与共享双模式，推动内存解耦实用化。
papers.abstract_en: CXL Memory Module - Memory Pooling (CMM-MP) introduces a novel memory pooling architecture to meet the unique requirements of emerging memory-intensive workloads. This industry-first, purpose-built memory-pooling device combines the benefits of Compute Express Link (CXL) with the scalability and cost advantages of Ethernet. Multiple CMM-MP devices together provide a flexible, composable, and disaggregated memory expansion solution. The CMM-MP enables 100s of TB capacity for GPU/CPU applications without modifications. The memory pool is exposed as a large-capacity logical aggregate memory, with all pool discovery, composition, and backend network datapath tasks fully offloaded to the device. CMM-MP supports both memory pooling and sharing usage modes. It provides an application latency of 2.7 us and up to 23 GB/s of memory throughput. Our evaluations demonstrate that CMM-MP significantly outperforms RDMA-based solutions in latency and throughput. We also evaluated real-world use cases of Valkey+YCSB and DiskANN using CMM-MP.

papers.title_en: gKSM: GPU Memory Deduplication at Driver Layer for Serverless LLM Inference
papers.authors: Shuheng Gao, Fan Guo, Yongkun Li, Ziye Yue, Yinlong Xu, John C. S. Lui
papers.evidence: 面向云服务器无服务LLM推理的GPU内存去重框架
papers.tldr: 服务器无服务器LLM推理中，多实例共驻单GPU导致模型权重与运行时状态重复占用GPU内存。gKSM在驱动层实现透明GPU内存去重，融合CPU-GPU协同哈希、零拷贝权重去重与跨特权页错误处理。实测GPU内存降低59.8%，内存受限下聚合吞吐提升2.15倍。首次在GPU侧高效支持写隔离与COW语义，显著提升资源利用率与服务可用性。
papers.abstract_en: In serverless LLM inference, cloud providers commonly locate multiple instances on a single GPU to improve utilization. However, each instance independently maintains its model weights and runtime state, making duplicate GPU memory the primary bottleneck. Memory deduplication is a widely-used technique for eliminating duplicate data in CPU systems, but extending it to GPU memory faces fundamental challenges. Effective GPU memory deduplication must avoid redundant data movement between CPU and GPU while preserving write isolation for shared pages without native copy-on-write (COW) support.   This paper presents gKSM, a transparent GPU memory deduplication framework for serverless LLM inference. gKSM addresses these challenges through CPU-GPU collaborative hash management that offloads hash computation to GPU kernels, zero-copy model weight deduplication that eliminates duplication before model weight transfer, and a cross-privilege page fault handler that combines a lightweight kernel hook and CUDA Virtual Memory Management (VMM) remapping in the user space. gKSM also designs a stable page scanning algorithm and a reuse-aware placement policy in cluster scale. Experiments show that gKSM reduces GPU memory usage by 59.8% while maintaining high throughput compared to ServerlessLLM. Under memory constrained workloads, gKSM improves aggregate throughput by 2.15X and supports five instances concurrently. In cluster level simulation, gKSM achieves a service rate of 99.97%, compared to 78.2% for SLInfer and 26.9% for ServerlessLLM.

papers.title_en: HyCo: Hybrid Drafting for Cost-Efficient Mobile-Cloud Speculative Decoding
papers.authors: Hanbin Bae, Heejin Choi, Joohyung Lee, Byoung Jin Choi, Sangjun Park, Hoon-Young Cho
papers.evidence: 移动-云协同推测解码架构
papers.tldr: 移动-云协同推测解码中，小语言模型（SLM）在手机NPU上多轮展开深draft树开销大。HyCo将服务器MTP头卸载至设备执行，SLM仅单次前向传播生成分支，并通过量化、受限词表与1K窗口适配NPU。相比服务端MTP自推测，GPU耗时降低29.2%–38.6%，且保持判分无显著下降。该设计兼顾效率、精度与端侧可行性。
papers.abstract_en: Device-cloud speculative decoding reduces server computation, but growing a deep draft tree with a small language model (SLM) requires repeated passes on a mobile neural processing unit (NPU). We present HyCo, which assigns depth to the server model's native multi-token prediction (MTP) head, executed on the device, and alternative branches to one SLM pass. The server returns the hidden state, input embedding, and key-value entries needed by the head instead of executing its sequential steps. Quantization, a restricted vocabulary, and a 1K-token window fit both drafters to the NPU. An ε-threshold rule additionally relaxes exact preservation of the verifier's sampling distribution. In single-client runs with a Galaxy S26 Ultra over LTE/5G, HyCo reduces server GPU time per output token relative to server-side MTP self-speculation by 38.6% on Spec-Bench and 29.2% on 32K-token summarization. With the same acceptance rule, three Spec-Bench runs per system show 9.0 percentage points more saving and 1.9x delivery speed than an SLM-only drafter. HyCo differs from Cloud+MTP by +0.2 judge-score points (paired 95% CI: -0.9 to +1.3); exploratory translation favors SpecEdge-ε. Without relaxation, HyCo exact saves 27.7% and 11.9% on the two datasets.

papers.title_en: Benchmarking Post-Quantum Key Encapsulation in S3-Compatible Object Storage under Client Concurrency
papers.authors: Revanth Reddy Lingala, K. Gangadhara Rao, Padigela Srujan, Saarthak Manocha, Vainavi Venkat
papers.evidence: S3兼容云对象存储中的后量子密钥封装基准测试
papers.tldr: 云对象存储中长期保存的数据面临量子计算威胁，需用ML-KEM等后量子密钥封装算法替代经典密钥交换。本文在S3兼容存储系统中，实测客户端并发场景下ML-KEM对吞吐量的影响。结果表明仅在CPU近满载时吞吐量下降4.0–4.9%，主因是库调用方式而非算法本身；存储开销固定增加1056字节/对象。该工作首次量化了真实存储负载下的PQ加密代价。
papers.abstract_en: Data encrypted today with classical public-key algorithms could be decrypted once large quantum computers exist. Cloud object stores keep data for years, so the client-side encryption that protects it must move to post-quantum algorithms such as ML-KEM, which adds a key-encapsulation step and a larger ciphertext to every stored object. So far, the cost of ML-KEM has been measured for the algorithm on its own and for securing network connections, but not for encrypting each object in a storage system that serves many clients at once. It has therefore been unclear whether ML-KEM slows such a system, under which conditions, and why. We address this problem by measuring per-object ML-KEM against classical key exchange on an S3-compatible object store, with two client implementations, two processor types and up to 500 concurrent workers, using pre-registered experiments and statistical equivalence tests. ML-KEM reduced throughput only when the client's processor was at or near full load, with one unexplained exception, and then by 4.0 to 4.9% in our main client. Controlled experiments on one processor type traced most of that loss to the way the software library was called, and a second, native client showed that the size of the loss depends on the implementation. The lasting cost is storage: 1,056 more bytes per object than with classical key exchange. The results cover two clients, one single-node store and one cloud provider.

papers.title_en: ScaleRAN: A Runtime for Elastic GPU Resource Management in AI-RAN
papers.authors: Arthur Hamard, Jérémie Leguay, Gopalasingham Aravinthan, Alberto Conte, Julien Lallet, Abdelkader Outtagarts
papers.evidence: 面向云原生基础设施的AI-RAN弹性GPU资源管理运行时
papers.tldr: AI-RAN需在GPU平台上协同运行时延敏感的RAN基带处理与AI任务，但现有GPU共享机制难以应对毫秒级slot负载波动。ScaleRAN基于NVIDIA Green Contexts实现SM级弹性分区，支持slot粒度动态资源重分配。实验表明其在保障RAN截止时间前提下显著提升AI任务可用GPU资源。该工作为O-RAN O-Cloud等AI-RAN部署提供了首个轻量、可预测的节点级GPU运行时。
papers.abstract_en: AI-RAN is driving the convergence of radio access network (RAN) processing and artificial intelligence (AI) workloads on GPU-enabled computing platforms, ranging from GPU-accelerated base stations to cloud-native infrastructures. While GPU acceleration improves the efficiency of virtualized RAN functions, the computational demand of latency-critical baseband processing varies with traffic load, creating transient spare GPU capacity that can be reclaimed by co-located AI applications. Existing GPU-sharing mechanisms rely on coarse-grained hardware partitioning or static resource allocation, limiting their ability to adapt to slot-level workload fluctuations while preserving strict timing requirements.   This paper presents ScaleRAN, a node-local runtime for elastic GPU resource management in AI-RAN. ScaleRAN leverages NVIDIA Green Contexts to dynamically partition Streaming Multiprocessors (SMs) between RAN and AI workloads through a ladder of pre-created GPU partitions, enabling low-overhead resource reallocation at RAN slot granularity. The proposed runtime naturally supports Open-RAN (O-RAN) O-Cloud deployments, one representative AI-RAN deployment scenario. To drive these reallocations, we propose a reactive controller inspired by Kubernetes autoscaling and a proactive controller based on quantile regression and conformal prediction. We also develop LDPCSim, a GPU-accelerated workload generator built on NVIDIA Aerial for reproducible evaluation. Results show that predictive fine-grained GPU partitioning satisfies slot-level RAN deadlines while increasing the GPU resources available to co-located AI workloads, demonstrating the practicality of elastic GPU sharing for future AI-RAN platforms.

papers.title_en: Task Offloading and Resource Allocation for Deterministic Service Provisioning in the IoT-Edge-Cloud Continuum
papers.authors: K. Aghababaiyan, B. Coll-Perales, J. Gozalvez
papers.evidence: 物联网-边缘-云连续体中的确定性任务卸载
papers.tldr: 物联网-边缘-云连续体需支撑确定性服务保障。本文提出面向SLO的确定性任务卸载与资源分配方案，以最大化按时完成任务数为目标，联合优化通信与计算资源。相比传统低延迟/低能耗策略，该方案通过差异化任务时延需求实现负载均衡与高优先级任务保障。实验表明其在资源扩展性与时限保证能力上显著提升。
papers.abstract_en: Future networks will seamlessly integrate computing and communication resources within a unified ecosystem of IoT devices, edge nodes, and cloud servers, forming an IoT-edge-cloud continuum. Within such an ecosystem, tasks can be dynamically offloaded to leverage resources across the continuum and efficiently scale with demand. Task offloading has traditionally focused on minimizing task execution latency or energy consumption. In contrast, we propose a deterministic task offloading and resource allocation scheme for the joint management of communication and computing resources to support services with deterministic service-level requirements. The proposed scheme aims to maximize the number of tasks completed on time, rather than minimizing the latency of individual tasks. To do so, it exploits variable task latency requirements to distribute the workload across the continuum. It can also prioritize high-priority tasks under resource scarcity. Numerical evaluations demonstrate that a deterministic task offloading strategy scales more effectively and can better guarantee timely task completion by balancing resource utilization across the continuum.

papers.title_en: CXLResume: Retained-State Checkpoint and Restore for In-Memory Services
papers.authors: Haonan Li, Zhaoxiang Huang, Zhihao Zhang, Yiming Zhang
papers.evidence: 基于CXL共享内存的内存服务检查点与恢复机制
papers.tldr: 内存服务传统检查点需全量拷贝内存页，开销巨大。CXLResume利用CXL共享内存保留主堆对象，仅序列化执行状态与映射元数据。Redis和Memcached在6 GiB场景下恢复时间降至0.24–0.28秒。该方法显著规避大堆数据搬运，为低延迟容错提供新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Checkpointing and restoring an in-memory service typically require writing its memory pages to checkpoint images and refilling them at the destination. When application state already resides in shared memory that remains accessible after failover, copying those pages into and out of checkpoint images is unnecessary. We present CXLResume, a prototype that retains the service's main heap objects in shared memory while checkpointing the remaining execution state and mapping metadata. Checkpointing preserves the shared heap at the same freeze point as the serialized process state. During recovery, CXLResume remaps the same shared memory at its original virtual addresses before restoring execution, preserving direct pointers within and across shared and private memory. We evaluate CXLResume with Redis and Memcached using QEMU CXL functional emulation. At 6 GiB, CXLResume reduces combined checkpoint and restore time from 15.015 s to 0.242 s for Redis and from 19.770 s to 0.276 s for Memcached in the evaluated deployments. These results show that retaining shared application state removes large application heaps from the checkpoint data path and substantially reduces checkpoint and restore latency.

papers.title_en: HAWK: Heterogeneity-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Efficient GPU-NPU Phase-Disaggregated LLM Inference
papers.authors: Junhyeok Park, Jungeun Yoon, Kyungmin Kim, Hunsoon Lee, Shinyoung Ahn, Kangho Kim
papers.evidence: 异构虚拟化系统中GPU-NPU相位分离的大语言模型推理
papers.tldr: LLM推理预填充（prefill）与解码（decode）阶段计算特性迥异，导致单一硬件难以兼顾效率。HAWK提出异构GPU-NPU协同架构，通过RDMA路径实现KV缓存跨设备零拷贝迁移。实测在SLO约束下性能达GPU单系统92.12%，功耗与成本效率分别提升1.26×和1.72×。该方案为相位解耦推理提供了实用化异构加速范式。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) inference exhibits distinct computational characteristics across its two phases: prefill is compute-intensive, whereas decode is more memory-bound. As a result, AI accelerators achieve varying levels of efficiency across the two phases. GPUs are well suited to prefill, but are often underutilized during decode. By contrast, NPUs can utilize their compute resources more effectively during decode. Motivated by this observation, we explore a heterogeneous architecture that integrates GPUs and NPUs, mapping prefill to GPUs and decode to NPUs to achieve high performance and efficiency. However, realizing such heterogeneous integration is challenging because LLM phase disaggregation requires KV cache transfer from prefill to decode (that is, from GPUs to NPUs), which is complicated by differences in inter-device communication mechanisms and KV cache tensor layouts.   To address this, we propose HAWK, a transfer mechanism that enables rapid KV cache transfer across heterogeneous devices. HAWK establishes a remote direct memory access (RDMA) path for direct cross-device transfers while handling inter-device tensor layout discrepancies as part of the transfer process. In particular, HAWK allocates tensor-layout-aware RDMA buffers on the NPU side to match the target tensor layout. Leveraging these buffers, HAWK orchestrates data transfer from a conventional contiguous GPU RDMA buffer to the corresponding NPU buffers, allowing transferred tensors to be consumed directly without additional data rearrangement while maintaining transfer efficiency. We implement and evaluate HAWK on a system built with commercially available GPUs and NPUs, demonstrating performance within 7.88% of a GPU-only system under the same SLO constraints while achieving up to 1.26$\times$ higher power efficiency and 1.72$\times$ higher cost efficiency.

papers.title_en: uGDS: A User-Space Development Kit for High-Performance GPU Direct Storage
papers.authors: Jing Wei, Guanyi Chen, Qi Chen, Chuyu Zhang, Zheng Zhou, Chutian Wang, Jian Zhang
papers.evidence: 用户态GPU Direct Storage库支持SSD-GPU直传，与QEMU虚拟化I/O栈兼容
papers.tldr: GPU密集型应用依赖NVMe SSD扩展显存，但NVIDIA GDS存在内核控制开销大、流序过度严格、闭源难定制等问题。uGDS构建全用户态GPU Direct Storage栈，解耦控制与数据路径，支持跨厂商抽象与细粒度调度。实测A100+990 PRO上批读/写带宽达GDS的12.12×/30.69×，TTFT降低62.7%。它是首个开源、跨CUDA/HIP、高透明且可诊断的GDS替代方案。
papers.abstract_en: Data-intensive GPU applications increasingly rely on NVMe SSDs to extend GPU memory. NVIDIA GPU Direct Storage (GDS) enables direct SSD-GPU transfers via PCIe peer-to-peer DMA, eliminating host staging. However, GDS retains three key limitations: (1) its control path traverses the kernel for every I/O request, introducing software overhead; (2) its stream-ordered path imposes strict total ordering even when workloads only require batch-level ordering; and (3) its closed-source user-space engine hinders diagnosis and custom scheduling.   We present uGDS, https://github.com/ScaleX-IO/uGDS, an open-source user-space GPU Direct Storage library built on four principles: user-space control, unified cross-vendor abstraction, workload-aware scheduling, and end-to-end transparency. The host CPU manages the entire NVMe command lifecycle in user space, while payloads move via PCIe P2P DMA without consuming GPU compute. A minimal kernel module (ugds_drv.ko) is used only for one-time privileged setup. uGDS partitions hardware queues between synchronous and batch traffic, enforces DMA-safe buffer lifetimes, and provides cuFile-compatible synchronous, batched, and stream-ordered APIs with polling or interrupt completion on both NVIDIA CUDA and AMD HIP.   Evaluated on an A100 with a Samsung 990 PRO, uGDS achieves up to 12.12x GDS's batch-read bandwidth and 30.69x its batch-write bandwidth (8- and 4-KiB requests, batch size 128), and reduces 4-KiB synchronous write latency by 84.1% with two threads. Its stream-ordered path sustains 5.49 GiB/s on a single stream, where GDS retains only 40.8% of its synchronous bandwidth. In LMCache, uGDS reduces median time-to-first-token (TTFT) by up to 62.7% and raises serving goodput by 2.63x. On AMD, uGDS achieves up to 1.19x hipFile's synchronous-write bandwidth.

papers.title_en: Task-State Governance: A Virtual Machine for Verifiable and Recoverable GUI Agent Execution
papers.authors: Wenkui Yang, Yiming Hao, Kai Zhou, Chengyu Pu, Yuzhe Zhang, Jie Cao, Jin Huang, Shuai Ma, Feng Tian
papers.evidence: TaskVM是一种用于可验证GUI智能体执行的虚拟机
papers.tldr: GUI代理在真实应用中执行任务时易发生状态漂移，用户难以追溯变更与恢复。本文提出任务态治理范式，构建TaskVM虚拟机实现可验证、可恢复的GUI执行。实验表明其提升契约合规性与用户恢复控制力，且不牺牲执行效果。该工作开辟了可治理代理界面的新设计空间。
papers.abstract_en: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents now execute workflows across real applications, but when execution drifts, users must determine what changed, what should have remained untouched, and what can still be recovered. Plan-centric interfaces leave users supervising procedure, but users live with changes to application state. We introduce task-state governance, an interaction paradigm that represents a task as an editable contract linking desired outcomes, facts that must be preserved, and observed application state. We instantiate this paradigm in TaskVM, which projects live state into editable task controls, executes user edits as genuine interface actions, verifies outcomes through independent observation, and marks each action as reversible, compensatable, or irreversible. Across an automated contract benchmark, a controlled user study, and an open live-model exploration, the paradigm strengthened contract compliance and users' recovery control and trust, while execution outcomes were held constant. Task contracts open a design space for governable agent interfaces.

papers.title_en: Amora: Communication-Efficient Private Approximate Nearest Neighbors Search
papers.authors: Qiuhao Wang, Zuowei Chen, Xu Yang, Saiyu Qi, Yong Qi
papers.evidence: 面向云托管向量数据库的私有近似最近邻搜索
papers.tldr: 云上近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）面临查询向量泄露用户敏感意图的隐私风险。Amora提出双PIR分片图索引与批量查询机制，将PIR开销从每顶点降至每分区。通信量降低93–99%，同时提升检索精度。显著推进单服务器私有ANNS的实用化边界。
papers.abstract_en: Approximate nearest neighbors search (ANNS) over cloud-hosted vector databases raises a critical privacy concern: the query vector, which often encodes sensitive user intent, is exposed to the server. Private ANNS (PANNS) allows a client to retrieve nearest neighbors without revealing its query. The state-of-the-art single-server scheme, Pacmann (ICLR'25), achieves high accuracy via graph-based search with private information retrieval (PIR), but incurs substantial communication overhead because each PIR query retrieves only a single vertex. We present Amora, a communication-efficient PANNS system that applies SimplePIR to a partitioned graph index so that one PIR query is amortized over many vertices. To retrieve as much of the distance and neighbor information the search needs under a limited communication budget, Amora adopts a dual-PIR split layout with two heterogeneous PIR matrices that stay balanced in dimension: VecPIR retrieves inner products for an entire partition of vertices as their distance at once, while NbrPIR retrieves necessary neighbor lists at subgroup granularity for graph traversal. This layout shifts the cost model of PIR query from per-vertex to per-partition, which significantly reduces the communication overhead. To further improve efficiency by reducing the number of scans and query rounds in the PIR database, Amora introduces batch PIR to pack multiple queries into one matrix multiplication, centroid-based pruning to filter unpromising partitions, and TopCand exploration that seeds jump-style graph navigation with the closest vertices from each retrieved partition. We evaluate Amora on five datasets spanning 96 to 1024 dimensions and up to 10 million vectors. Compared to Pacmann, Amora reduces online communication by 93--99% while achieving higher search accuracy.

papers.title_en: PrairieFire: Igniting High-Throughput Updates in Large-Scale Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
papers.authors: Yuchen Huang, Baiteng Ma, Yiping Sun, Xiao Chen, Rui Ma, Yue Chen, Jinwei Zhang, Xiaocheng Zhong, Zhiyong Wang, Yao Hu, Erci Xu, Chuliang Weng
papers.evidence: 面向云规模检索的SSD加速近似最近邻搜索系统
papers.tldr: 现代NVMe SSD阵列带宽逼近内存但成本更低，百亿级向量ANNS正转向SSD部署。现有方案因CPU密集型更新路径导致吞吐瓶颈，难以应对数据与模型持续更新。PrairieFire通过缓冲更新、批处理局部重建及CPU-GPU-SSD协同设计突破限制。实测更新吞吐达SOTA系统3–35倍，搜索吞吐保持3–5倍，成本效率提升1.5–8.7倍。
papers.abstract_en: Arrays of modern NVMe SSDs are approaching memory in terms of bandwidth while offering much lower cost per gigabyte. Hence, approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) for billion-scale vectors in applications such as recommendation, search, and retrieval-augmented generation increasingly runs on SSD-based systems. Unfortunately, due to the limited update throughput of existing SSD-based solutions, the indexed corpus cannot keep pace with continuous modifications to data and embedding models, thus hindering broader deployment across more scenarios and larger scales.   The bottleneck lies in CPU-intensive update paths, where foreground insertions incur frequent SSD accesses and background reassignments repeatedly relocate each vector, making high update throughput difficult to achieve even by exhausting available hardware. In this paper, using buffered updates and batched local rebuilds, we develop PrairieFire with cascaded adjustments, concurrency control, and CPU-GPU-SSD cooperation. These co-designs avoid frequent SSD accesses in foreground updates and heavy background reassignments, achieving high update throughput while maintaining excellent search performance.   Evaluations show that, compared with state-of-the-art systems, PrairieFire can sustain approximately 3-35x update throughput while maintaining approximately 3-5x search throughput simultaneously. It also achieves approximately 1.5-8.7x cost efficiency. PrairieFire has been deployed in RedNote's production environments for two months, improving business metrics by higher freshness without frequent index rebuilds.

papers.title_en: SigmaTrace: Library-Agnostic Observability for CPU/GPU-Initiated RDMA Communication
papers.evidence: 面向大规模系统虚拟化通信的RDMA可观测性
papers.tldr: RDMA网络在大规模系统中广泛应用，但缺乏细粒度可观测性，尤其GPU发起的RDMA操作完全不可见。SigmaTrace在libibverbs/mlx5dv层实现库无关追踪，采用内存插桩技术首次无侵入式捕获GPU端内核RDMA行为。实测NCCL/RCCL通信开销仅增1.3%–2%，并发现现有工具无法识别的内核屏障扩散与2.13倍跨节点流量倾斜。该工作填补了CPU/GPU协同RDMA可观测性的关键空白。
papers.abstract_en: RDMA networking enables low-latency, high-bandwidth communication on large systems. Despite its adoption, however, observability is lacking. Existing tools target specific communication libraries or only report aggregated data, missing per-operation behavior. The gap is widest for GPU-initiated networking, whose in-kernel RDMA operations are invisible to the host.   We present SigmaTrace, a library-agnostic RDMA profiling framework providing fine-grained, per-operation visibility for CPU and GPU-initiated networking. It traces operations at the libibverbs/mlx5dv layers, the common denominator beneath communication libraries on InfiniBand and RoCE, and employs a low-overhead memory interposition technique that, to our knowledge, gives the first observability into GPU-initiated RDMA without source patching or binary instrumentation.   Host-side tracing adds 1.3% overhead on NCCL AllReduce at 128 GPUs and under 2% on RCCL at 1024 GPUs. On a persistent-kernel BFS and Mixture-of-Experts inference, SigmaTrace exposes an in-kernel barrier spread and 2.13x inter-node traffic skew invisible to existing profilers.

papers.title_en: PlaneZip: Lossless Bit-Plane Compression of Training Activations Offloaded over PCIe
papers.authors: Zhufan Gu, Qizhe Tang, Yuxin Wang, Xun Zhou, Hui Feng
papers.evidence: 面向内存受限虚拟化训练的PCIe卸载压缩
papers.tldr: GPU训练受显存限制需频繁卸载激活值，但PCIe带宽瓶颈使传统交换代价高昂。PlaneZip在拷贝路径上实时进行位平面无损压缩，并重构调度器以适配压缩后传输时间。在五种真实模型上，BF16/FP32激活平均压缩率达1.71x/1.39x，显著优于零值压缩。该方法大幅降低重计算开销，硬件开销仅0.036 mm²。
papers.abstract_en: Training under a device-memory budget relies on tensor rematerialization: an evicted activation is either swapped to host memory or dropped and recomputed. Because GPU compute has outgrown PCIe bandwidth, cost-model planners such as MegTaiChi, which charge a swap its full transfer time, almost never swap, and swaps that fill idle link time carry only a small fraction of the saved activations. Saved activations, however, are homogeneously typed arrays with bit-level redundancy beyond zeros, which lightweight bit-plane compressors can remove at line rate. We present PlaneZip, which compresses swapped tensors on the copy path and plans around the compression. Its codec picks, for every 128-byte block, the smallest of zero-value, delta bit-plane, bit-plane, and a new zero-masked bit-plane encoding. A per-tensor predictor reuses the ratio of the previous iteration, and the planner budgets link time in compressed transfer times. On activations captured from five models trained on real data, the codec compresses BF16 activations by 1.71x and FP32 activations by 1.39x (geometric means), against 1.18x and 1.20x for zero-value compression. In trace-driven simulation of a PCIe 3.0 consumer GPU and a PCIe 4.0 datacenter GPU at half the activation memory, PlaneZip cuts the rematerialization overhead by 47% and 31% relative to a bandwidth-aware planner without compression, and by 73% and 54% relative to MegTaiChi's cost model, with an estimated engine area of 0.036 square millimeters.

papers.title_en: A Critical Review of Grid Integration Challenges and Flexibility Opportunities for Large-Scale Data Centers
papers.authors: Bibek Dhakal, Manohar Chamana, Biswambhar Gayen, Jatendar Kumar, S M Shams Rahman, Aaqib Peerzada, Ki Yeob Lee, Olatunji M. Adeyanju, Bhaskar Mitra, Soumya Kundu, Stephen Bayne
papers.evidence: 云计算数据中心基础设施与电网集成挑战
papers.tldr: AI与云计算驱动数据中心负荷激增，其高密度、变流器主导、热电耦合等特性带来新型电网接入挑战。本文系统梳理配电层关键问题并对比七类负荷模型，评估多维度灵活性资源。发现仅靠峰荷与年电量匹配无法保障可靠可持续接入。研究为数据中心-电网协同规划提供了全链条评估框架。
papers.abstract_en: The rapid proliferation of cloud computing and artificial intelligence workloads is fundamentally reshaping the magnitude, spatial concentration, and electrical characteristics of data center power demand. Data centers differ from conventional commercial loads because they combine high rack densities, converter-dominated interfaces, thermally coupled cooling, uninterruptible power supplies, programmable workloads, and increasingly complex behind-the-meter generation and storage within a single facility. This review examines their grid integration from utility and sustainable-energy perspectives across resource planning, large-load interconnection, distribution feeders, market operation, real-time dynamics, power quality, and asset management. Particular attention is given to distribution-level issues that receive limited treatment in broader energy reviews: bidirectional operation on renewable-rich feeders, harmonic propagation and resonance, ride-through and reconnection, transformer derating, cable ampacity, neutral-conductor heating, protection, and measurement. Static, composite, physics-based dynamic, calibrated, impedance, electromagnetic transient, and hybrid load models are compared according to study purpose and data requirements, and utility coordination platforms, uninterruptible power supply and battery control, workload flexibility, renewable co-location, cogeneration, fuel cells, thermal storage, and clean firm supply are assessed. The central finding is that requested peak demand and annual energy matching alone cannot establish reliable or sustainable integration. Credible assessment must consider hourly and locational supply, network deliverability, marginal emissions, lifecycle and water impacts, backup obligations, rebound, asset health, and verified operating capability.

papers.title_en: Data Center Load Accommodation under QoS and Checkpoint-Induced Frequency Security Constraints
papers.authors: Ruolan Cui, Ziang Liu, Chenxi Hu, Francis Yunhe Hou
papers.evidence: 面向AI工作负载动态性与电网约束的数据中心负荷接纳
papers.tldr: AI训练负载激增推动数据中心与电网深度耦合，但传统DCLA评估忽略QoS与频率安全约束。本文提出联合建模QoS、checkpoint-induced FS及电网充裕性的两阶段字典序优化方法。相比基准，DCLA高估达40.3%；QoS为主导瓶颈，FS约束随训练负载增长而加剧。成果支撑兼顾电网支撑价值与运行风险的可靠DCLA评估。
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence workloads is accelerating the expansion and grid interconnection of data centers (DCs). Existing data center load accommodation (DCLA) assessments primarily focus on grid and resource adequacy and often imply that greater workload flexibility always increases accommodable capacity. However, workload flexibility has a dual effect. Workload deferral and temporal shifting can alleviate network congestion, whereas synchronized checkpointing of training workloads can cause large and rapid load reductions, threatening frequency stability. Therefore, DCLA cannot be determined solely by grid adequacy. This paper develops an optimal DCLA method that jointly accounts for workload quality of service (QoS), checkpoint-induced frequency security (FS), and grid adequacy. First, a QoS-aware model characterizes workload-dependent flexibility while ensuring service feasibility. Second, checkpoint-induced FS constraints are developed for periodic and event-triggered power variations, with key frequency-security limits reformulated in algebraic form. Third, a two-stage lexicographic model is developed to maximize DCLA and minimizes the required energy storage (ES) deployment, and then optimizes system operation under the given DC and ES siting and sizing decisions. Case studies show that the proposed method avoids a 40.3% overestimation of DCLA compared with the grid-adequacy benchmark. QoS is the primary limiting factor, while checkpoint-induced frequency-security constraints become more restrictive as training workloads increase. These findings highlight that reliable DCLA should account for both its grid-support value and the associated QoS and FS risks.

papers.title_en: RemoteANN: A Native Vector Search Engine for Cloud Object Storage
papers.authors: Yutong Gou, Silu Huang, Yue Wang, Jianjun Chen, Cheng Long
papers.evidence: 专为云对象存储协同设计的向量搜索引擎
papers.tldr: 云对象存储上的向量检索因网络延迟高、请求开销大而面临I/O放大与吞吐瓶颈。RemoteANN面向S3类存储原生设计，融合IVF索引、RaBitQ量化与数据重排序提升局部性。查询阶段结合簇剪枝、Range-GET、请求合并与NVMe缓存，大幅降低请求数与传输量。在97%召回率下实现5.9×吞吐提升与16.1×请求削减，显著降本增效。
papers.abstract_en: Vector search engines built on cloud object storage have drawn growing attention from both academia and industry. These systems typically adopt a disaggregated storage-compute architecture, persisting the primary vector payload in object stores (e.g., Amazon S3) while retaining compact index metadata on compute nodes. However, conventional vector indexing structures are not natively tailored to the pronounced network latency and per-request access costs of cloud object stores, resulting in network I/O amplification, degraded query throughput, and higher API expenses.   To resolve these challenges, we present RemoteANN, a vector search engine explicitly co-designed for cloud object storage across indexing and querying. To mitigate the dominant network I/O bottleneck, RemoteANN couples an Inverted File (IVF) index with RaBitQ quantization, further optimized by inter-cluster and intra-cluster data reordering for improved data locality. Building on this tailored data layout, RemoteANN's query engine combines cluster pruning, fine-grained Range-GET requests, request merging, and local NVMe SSD caching, dramatically reducing discrete storage requests and network transfer volume without sacrificing accuracy. To address the index construction bottleneck, we further develop QGKMeans, which substantially reduces construction latency without compromising clustering quality. Extensive evaluations on real-world datasets demonstrate that, compared with representative baselines, RemoteANN achieves up to a $5.9\times$ throughput speedup while issuing up to $16.1\times$ fewer object storage requests at 97% target recall.
